scope.snapshot_note: Facts below describe the 7a36a39 planning baseline. Later M10.9.6 implementation and fresh tests belong to their owning plans/coverage ledger; this snapshot is not a live completion claim.
scope.contract_resolution: Each surface/dynamic/family record names one shared contracts key. That record supplies its exact modern counterpart, remaining obligation, acceptance and source paths without copying identical prose into every old option.
scope.effective_defaults_note: Per-option constructor_default is not the complete effective default: natural.config.js and global/local deep merging may override it; D02-D04 and defaults-composition retain that review.
scope.acceptance_resolution: For each entry, contracts[contract] supplies its concrete counterpart, remaining gap, next slice and focused acceptance. Each profiles ID resolves required acceptance IDs and the frozen original acceptance descriptions through families[profile].acceptance_ref.

distinctions.implemented_contract_with_open_edges: An implemented modern central contract has code and historical owning tests; default/option/dynamic closure is still required.
distinctions.required_gap: A concrete behavior is missing or differs at the baseline and must be implemented or explicitly resolved.
distinctions.integration_recipe: The outcome can use authored HTML/CSS, standard APIs and existing handles; publish and test the concrete recipe before closing it.
distinctions.integration_recipe_with_open_edges: The replacement is viable but specific defaults/options/callback or author-layout proof remains.
distinctions.integration_recipe_with_contract_review: Current API intentionally separates policy; select and test the minimal replacement contract before closure.
distinctions.review_required: Declared intent and actual legacy defect differ; resolve the owning contract rather than preserving a no-op.
distinctions.cross_owner_required_gap: The owning core/UI milestone must preserve the workflow; Grid alone cannot close it.

repaired_legacy_defects.modern: Before hooks reject unchanged; post callbacks report committed changes only.
Explicit previous/next IDs and immutable committed payloads; no copied broken bookkeeping.

repaired_legacy_defects.legacy: check-all removeProp and single-check removeAttr do not clear live checked state
repaired_legacy_defects.modern: Controlled independent checked IDs and native checked/indeterminate state.

repaired_legacy_defects.legacy: focusout string coercion dirties untouched numeric/boolean values
repaired_legacy_defects.modern: Raw parsing/deep comparison and no-op tracking, not accidental type mutation.
Stable-ID removal does not shift a later target; test projected delete batches as application operations.

repaired_legacy_defects.legacy: copy shares data and cloned form instance
repaired_legacy_defects.modern: Deep independent copy/new inserted ID; retain original snapshot identity for move.

repaired_legacy_defects.legacy: offscreen val silently skips rowStatus and notification
repaired_legacy_defects.modern: Rows mutation tracks offscreen edits and notifies all shared views.

repaired_legacy_defects.legacy: full rebind marks every field of an updated row dirty
repaired_legacy_defects.modern: Compare each compiled raw path against immutable original; do not mark unchanged nested siblings.

repaired_legacy_defects.legacy: Grid declares fRules/vRules/tpBind but omits forwarding them to bound row Forms
repaired_legacy_defects.modern: Keep their intended programmatic-rules outcomes under a consistent contract; declaration no-op is not an omission approval.

repaired_legacy_defects.legacy: nonpaged onBind first-page flag false above scrollPaging.size
repaired_legacy_defects.modern: Define first/last flags from actual completed rendering/chunk boundaries.

pending_decisions.condition: Retain all G03/G13/G14 outcomes. Add to the single consolidated user decision only if an actual framework capability remains unsupported; no exclusion is approved here.
pending_decisions.disposition: No omission approved. First prove an equivalent modern workflow; only an actual unsupported capability belongs in the one consolidated user decision.

pending_decisions.condition: Prove equivalent pinning/footer/resize/reflow outcomes or record exact remaining customization loss in the same complete omission batch. No Grid feature is proposed for omission by this record.
pending_decisions.disposition: No omission approved. First prove an equivalent modern workflow; only an actual unsupported capability belongs in the one consolidated user decision.

pending_decisions.condition: Grid templates, code lists, row event context and binding-before-action behavior stay required; no duplicate approval request or unused claim.
pending_decisions.disposition: No omission approved. First prove an equivalent modern workflow; only an actual unsupported capability belongs in the one consolidated user decision.

verification.note: Classification is code-backed planning. It does not convert earlier selected-scope tests into exhaustive legacy parity certification. No old helper is classified unused merely because modern implementation does not call it.

advanced-capabilities.remaining_obligation: All six explicitly requested advanced capabilities have implemented central contracts; exhaustive option/default and dynamic acceptance is still required.
advanced-capabilities.acceptance: Replay independent layouts and installed consumers with frozen fixtures; do not infer historical reorder/range/virtualization from legacy multiselect/scrollPaging.

defaults-composition.remaining_obligation: Old deep merge and local-first/global-second callback composition need an exact tested recipe; a local false suppresses global and otherwise global return controls. Do not introduce a generic config registry.
defaults-composition.acceptance: Test local false, undefined, true, throw and async rejection boundaries plus per-instance isolation and rule/message replacement.

root-inspection.remaining_obligation: Publish concrete root/template/native topology inspection recipes. Exposed mutable jQuery instance fields and table matrices are not unused; unsupported external capability requires the single consolidated decision.
root-inspection.acceptance: Exercise caller-authored inspection/customization against multi-tr records, spans and columns without copying a private compiler or adding a generic table utility.

native-topology.remaining_obligation: Core native topology is implemented. Complete remaining authored layout/root/offset correspondence and public helper inspection recipes, without copied headers or a utility package.
native-topology.acceptance: Test spans/groups/footer/pinning/width/reorder/hide and independent layouts plus external native inspection recipes.

current_counterpart: viewport root and both sticky occlusion bands
sticky-layout.remaining_obligation: Old split-table/fixed-column correction numbers and positioned-root selectors need explicit CSS/native layout replacement proof. Do not call actively read misc helpers unused.
sticky-layout.acceptance: Demonstrate responsive multi-row headers/footer and multiple pinned columns through width/hide/reorder/root containment, or retain an exact unsupported customization for the single decision.

height-controls.remaining_obligation: Owned height behavior is implemented; old initial CSS dimensions and automatic action-scroll flag/default equivalence still need explicit migration acceptance.
height-controls.acceptance: Test authored CSS dimensions/containment and every add/append/select/check/validate scroll policy without adding a second scroller.

column-chooser.remaining_obligation: Existing single-column controls do not finish old checkbox chooser/count/select-all workflow. Retain an authored recovery/action column when allowing every business column hidden; do not silently relax the all-columns-hidden guard.
column-chooser.acceptance: Build authored chooser with checkbox state/count/all/reset and a visible recovery control, stable focus and meaningful all-business-hidden state.

header-sort.remaining_obligation: Modern ascending/descending/clear supports directions; finish legacy two-state/default/rebind/filter/callback correspondence. Marker presentation is authored, not a new HTML-string option.
header-sort.acceptance: Test raw comparators, both directions and explicit clear, sort/filter/reset interactions, stable rows/drafts and authored labels/indicators.

column-filter.remaining_obligation: Legacy Search/Enter applies matches immediately and blank restores all; current search only narrows choices. Current choice list drops other-column-filter-excluded values rather than retaining full universe with zero counts.
column-filter.acceptance: Supply authored apply/Enter/clear using existing APIs and seed distinct raw values before counting other filters; test zero counts, reappearance, raw identities, search versus filtering and reset.

row-merge.remaining_obligation: Core repeated-value presentation is implemented. Complete old dependency/format/default/dynamic correspondence; do not preserve broken row ownership or unbounded virtual windows.
row-merge.acceptance: Test raw scalar identity, hierarchy, edited/status splits, all-scalar templates, remount/page boundaries, hidden columns and exact authored restoration.

paste.remaining_obligation: Core safe paste is implemented. Legacy offscreen direct writes without status/notification and invalid partial edits are defects, not required quirks; complete control/callback/policy correspondence.
paste.acceptance: Test quoted tabs/newlines/arrays, protected positions, column order, readonly/disabled fields, precise error, unchanged invalid batch, one event and undo/revert.

data-projections.remaining_obligation: Retain last-edited deleted snapshots, keep original-valued modern delete changes, and prove separate legacy current-value/status/field projections. Explicitly decide any incoming rowStatus metadata import workflow before claiming equivalence.
data-projections.acceptance: Test live/all/status/modified plus single-active versus batch-selected versus checked projections, nested/raw JSON, own-property field picks and legacy wire rowStatus mapping.

template-cache.remaining_obligation: cache=false and template mutation/tpBind event dedup mechanisms need an explicit modern ownership/rebind recipe. No broad mutation observer or runtime selector parser is justified by old switches alone.
template-cache.acceptance: Verify duplicate listeners never accumulate and authored template changes apply through controlled dispose/rebind; retain onBind/revert semantics.

row-selection.remaining_obligation: Legacy unselect=true toggles an already selected row on plain click; legacy multiselect also plain-toggles without modifiers. Current single same-ID activation is a no-op and multiple plain click replaces membership. Row-wide click opt-in also needs an explicit policy.
row-selection.acceptance: Add minimal explicit toggle/row activation policy while retaining current default and idempotent programmatic select; prove veto, keyboard, previous/current identity, selection/check independence and interactive-content exclusion.

row-checks.remaining_obligation: Core exclusive/multiple/mixed checks are implemented. Finish old selector/append/full-replacement and scope recipes; do not preserve removeProp/removeAttr checked-state defects.
row-checks.acceptance: Test both check-all directions, single-mode ambiguous proposals, zero/one/many eligible targets, outside-scope checks, DOM-data checkbox separation and no selection activation.

row-lifecycle.remaining_obligation: Core row resources and completion suppression are explicit. Finish first/last chunk flags, global/local composition and update/revert ordering; old onSelect-after-veto and broken beforeRow bookkeeping are repaired rather than retained.
row-lifecycle.acceptance: Test local/global deterministic composition, before/value/after/action ordering, ordinary mutation versus full completion, reentry/disposal/failure and fresh Rows snapshots.

row-defaults.remaining_obligation: Input-only captured defaults are implemented; finish legacy omitted-data versus explicit fields/position semantics and custom parser failure checks without as-T casts or per-row Forms.
row-defaults.acceptance: Test primitive/native groups/nested fields, complete application factories, explicit overrides, end insertion and source preservation.

change-status.remaining_obligation: Per-field changed presentation is absent. remove currently resets current to original, losing last-edited tombstone display and current-value legacy delete projection. Legacy full binding coarsely marked every field in updated rows; do not recreate that defect.
change-status.acceptance: Compare compiled raw nested leaf paths to immutable originals; verify siblings, arrays/groups, revert-to-original, drafts versus committed values, inserted/deleted policies, offscreen remount and protected tombstones.

validation-policy.remaining_obligation: Legacy validate=false allowed commits without rule checks and validate() examined changed/already-invalid rendered rows; modern explicit validate checks all live rows. Define tested author/selection-of-validation recipes, never claim manual timing alone disables validation.
validation-policy.acceptance: Test chosen validation scopes/policies, explicit changed-ID validation, no untouched false dirtiness, invalid drafts, hidden/off-page fields and failure focus.

native-controls.remaining_obligation: Complete field-to-tuples configuration, readonly/disabled interaction and incoming legacy status edge acceptance. Local Form owns file inputs; JSON Grid file exclusion is an explicit contract, not proof that all old controls are closed.
native-controls.acceptance: Replay radio/checkbox/multiple Select, raw numeric/boolean/null choices, nested edits, offscreen validation/paste and programmatic rule application.

row-order.remaining_obligation: Review addTop/index positions relative to retained tombstones: current before targets must be live, so leading/all-deleted anchors cannot be used. Keep edit/copy sources nondeleted and preserve modern deep independent copy.
row-order.acceptance: Test zero/top/end/before/self/no-op, stable IDs, leading and all-deleted stores, sorted/filtered views and subscriber failures; document any anchor contract change.

shared-updates.remaining_obligation: Modern subscriptions replace DataSync registration/update. Complete exact suppression and field-hook ordering while preserving whole-row/offscreen status tracking and observer failures.
shared-updates.acceptance: Test multiple UIs, targeted and whole-row updates, offscreen edits, replace/revert/append/move, committed subscriber failures and no duplicate completion.

display.remaining_obligation: Rich output capability is implemented; finish intended HTML-mode correspondence through explicit application-created trusted DOM. Interactive merged controls remain guarded ownership, not a legacy bug to reproduce.
display.acceptance: Test text literalness, fresh same-document DOM, image alt/source, renderer failure cleanup, nested values and merge ownership.

action-reveal.remaining_obligation: Explicit alignment alone does not prove legacy automatic defaults. Old select/check center last target; indexed add centers; top/end add scrolls even outside addScroll branch; append bottoms only for append start >0; validateScroll reveals last invalid.
action-reveal.acceptance: Provide tested action wrappers or minimal owned options for each declared outcome; retain filters/pages and user focus policies explicitly.

hover.remaining_obligation: Old hover class is presentation; add explicit authored CSS correspondence and accessible keyboard state rather than a visual theme.
hover.acceptance: Check hover/focus-visible on both authored layouts without changing data/selection or creating framework design.

progressive-render.remaining_obligation: Legacy progressive prefix rendering, per-row yielding and first/last chunk completion are not implemented by current synchronous bounded virtualization. Old scrollPaging operates on already-loaded data, not network fetching.
progressive-render.acceptance: Define optional bounded scheduling/chunk completion through current row/viewport owners, preserve cancellation/reentry/failure and append; do not reintroduce a timer/network engine or claim equivalence from paging alone.

field-rules.remaining_obligation: Declared legacy fRules/vRules are field-to-tuples, while RuleSet maps rule names to functions; Grid failed to forward old options. Define one tested programmatic-field declaration recipe/contract for all binders, not a silent no-op or duplicated registry.
field-rules.acceptance: Exercise effective per-field rule declarations, custom rule catalog overrides, native constraints and error timing; preserve all framework-reachable rules.

messages.remaining_obligation: Complete all old Grid message outcomes in authored examples, especially apply-search and chooser labels; no application-wide translation engine is required.
messages.acceptance: Swap authored labels/rule messages across two layouts while preserving native names and empty/no-results meaning.

row-events.remaining_obligation: Old e.* delegated arbitrary-selector callbacks ran after direct row Form edits. A row-hook listener now runs before Grid root delegation; button actions alone do not prove general event context/order equivalence.
row-events.acceptance: Specify typed stable-RowId post-edit event ordering and scoped cleanup before retiring string declarations; verify change/input/nonbutton events and committed/invalid data context.

row-details.remaining_obligation: Authored inline/Popup detail/navigation/validation is implemented. Demonstrate old all-fields/chosen-field outcomes and chooser integration; general Popup dragging/retained/guard policy remains M7 ownership.
row-details.acceptance: Replay hidden fields, shared nested edits, previous/next/close validation, no wrap, stale IDs, raw tombstone page positions, forced cleanup and chosen authored fields.
